title: RSA without secure padding
message: An RSA operation uses no padding, or RSA encryption uses PKCS#1 v1.5 padding.
remediation: Use OAEP for encryption or PSS for signatures.

title: Hardcoded or predictable key
message: A key or key-derivation password originates from a source-code literal, bundled plaintext resource, or predictable system property.
remediation: Load keys from a protected secret store or derive them from a strong secret with a KDF.
